title: Cracks as you work with this
text: Cracks as you work with this. I have used 4 different types of window tint, this one is sadly the worst. As you can see from the photos, it cracks as you handle it, so watch out. It is very brittle. It is too expensive to waste it, so I put it on the window anyway. You can see in the other photo that the cracking isn't that visible, but you can definitely see it. Once it is damp, it was fine, but you have to be able to cut this while it is dry and that's when it cracks. I won't buy this again.
